assets.description: Iconic E.Leclerc circular logo featuring blue ring and split blue-orange 'L' mark. Clean, minimal design suitable for corner placement or lockup integration in banner headers. Works as top-left logo anchor or supplementary branding element.

Garden furniture promotion banner featuring two woven chairs with cushions, umbrella, and hanging planter on warm gradient background (orange to coral-pink). Bold '25%' discount badge and 'Voir la sélection' CTA in blue button. Clean product staging ideal for hero placement with promotional urgency.

LEGO Bonnes Affaires campaign on turquoise radial-burst background showcasing Harry Potter castle set, motorcycle build, and Creator animal set. Features 'COUP DE POÏNG' label, LEGO logo, discount badge '-40%', and 'En profiter' button. Dynamic layout perfect for product rotation as feature hero.

DIY/Bricolage charcoal barbecue product shot on warm beige background showing packaged product and key product details (€11.99 unit price). Includes '-50% SUR LE 2ÈME PRODUIT ACHETÉ' badge and 'Acheter' blue button. Text-heavy layout with strong pricing anchor ideal for Click & Collect promotion.

Grocery shelf scenario with dairy products and discount tag '-15%' in sharp focus on blurred supermarket aisle background. Conveys in-store promotional urgency and real-world shopping context. Versatile hero for grocery/food category campaigns with authentic retail atmosphere.
